description: Dependency updates with digest pins. third_party/ is a pristine upstream copy and is never updated by Renovate.
tools/vectorgen/go.mod pins the qrysm oracle the golden vectors record; it moves only in a deliberate commit that regenerates them and updates PROVENANCE.md.
tools/vectorgen/contract/go.mod pins the qrysm client the contract check drives; it moves only in a deliberate commit that follows tools/vectorgen/README.md (Contract pin).

github.com/theQRL/go-qrl (LGPL-3.0) is pinned at one commit in go.mod; it moves only in a deliberate commit that updates NOTICE.execution, TestGoQRLRequirement, the LICENSES/ GNU texts and the gqrl-e2e build with it.

LocalStack 4.14.0 is the last release that serves Secrets Manager without LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN, which neither make test-cloud nor the cloud-secrets job has: its image (Makefile and ci.yml) gets digest updates only, until a token is wired in.
Tool versions pinned in workflow env, marked with a '# renovate:' comment.
Images pinned by digest in Go test code (the systemd smoke test's distribution), marked with a '// renovate: datasource=docker' comment on the line before.
Images pinned by digest in Makefile variables (the secret-store test servers), marked with a '# renovate: datasource=docker' comment on the line before.
